value.rationale: This computes natural hub-augmented bidirected cycles, an important contrast with recently classified bidirected polygons. The first five distinct homology degrees occur at a mathematically natural finite cutoff, with four lower groups not determined by existing top-homology generalities. Every smaller wheel is exhaustively checked.
